name: Chaos Incarnate — Starter Commander Deck Precon
commander: Kardur, Doomscourge (single commander — Starter decks have no alt commander)
bracket: 1-2 (Starter line is the simplest, most budget precon product)
theme: Goad + chaos — Kardur forces opponents' creatures to attack each other, drains life when attacking creatures die; symmetrical damage/pain payoffs (Dictate of the Twin Gods, Spiteful Visions, Stormfist Crusader) and big demons finish

name: Elven Council — LOTR: Tales of Middle-earth Commander Precon
commander: Galadriel, Elven-Queen (deck supports 5 other viable commanders in the 99: Gandalf Westward Voyager, Círdan, Elrond, Erestor, Radagast)
bracket: 1-2 (0 Game Changers, no infinite combos out of the box)
theme: Elf typal + voting/politics ("will of the council" mechanics), with a big-creature subtheme

name: Grave Danger — Starter Commander Deck Precon
commander: Gisa and Geralf (single commander — Starter decks have no alt commander)
bracket: 1-2 (Starter line is the simplest, most budget precon product)
theme: Zombie typal + graveyard recursion — fill the graveyard, recast Zombies from it with Gisa and Geralf, swarm with Zombie tokens and drain payoffs (Gray Merchant, Diregraf Captain, Vengeful Dead)

name: Halo Proxy Deck ("Master Chief, Spartan Hero") — Custom Boros Equipment/Vehicles
commander: Astor, Bearer of Blades (proxied as "Master Chief, Spartan Hero")
bracket: 3 (verified: 2 Game Changers — Ancient Tomb, Farewell — within the ≤3 limit)
theme: Equipment + Vehicles — Astor digs for gear, equips for {1}, and lets creatures crew Vehicles cheaply; voltron beats and go-wide Equipment payoffs
status: Custom proxy deck, purchased from Etsy seller (Halo full-art reskins of real cards). NOT legal for sanctioned play; requires playgroup/rule-0 approval.

name: Temur Roar — Tarkir: Dragonstorm Commander Precon
commander: Ureni of the Unwritten (featured alt commander in the 99: Eshki, Temur's Roar)
theme: Dragon typal — ramp into big Dragons, cheat them into play (Dragonstorm cards manifest/reveal Dragons from the library), haste + attack payoffs (Dragon Tempest, Temur Ascendancy, Xenagos-style damage)

name: Veloci-Ramp-Tor — The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander Precon
commander: Pantlaza, Sun-Favored (alt commander in the 99: Wayta, Trainer Prodigy)
theme: Dinosaur typal + big-mana ramp — accelerate mana early, cast huge Dinosaurs, Pantlaza's discover ability chains more Dinosaurs onto the battlefield; minor enrage (fight/damage-matters) subtheme

name: Jeskai Striker (Tarkir) — Tarkir: Dragonstorm Commander Precon
commander: Shiko and Narset, Unified (featured alt commander: Elsha, Threefold Master)
bracket: 2 (0 Game Changers, no stock infinite combos)
theme: Spellslinger — cast multiple spells per turn to trigger "flurry" (second spell each turn) effects; Shiko copies that second spell if it targets, or draws a card. Token swarms (Monastery Mentor, Third Path Iconoclast, Young Pyromancer) and cost reduction/ritual mana (Storm-Kiln Artist, Mana Geyser, Goblin Electromancer) fuel the chain.

name: Counter Intelligence — Edge of Eternities Commander Precon
commander: Kilo, Apogee Mind (featured alt commander: Inspirit, Flagship Vessel)
theme: Artifacts + counters — proliferate charge/+1/+1/indestructible counters across an artifact-heavy board; Darksteel Reactor as a build-around alt win-con, Hangarback Walker/Steel Overseer/Crystalline Crawler as counter payoffs

name: Lorehold Spirit — Secrets of Strixhaven Commander Precon
commander: Quintorius, History Chaser (featured alt commander: Excava, the Risen Past)
theme: Spirits + graveyard recursion — buff a growing Spirit token army while replaying spells/creatures out of the graveyard (Sevinne's Reclamation, Karmic Guide, Faithless Looting)

name: Quandrix Unlimited — Secrets of Strixhaven Commander Precon
commander: Zimone, Infinite Analyst (featured alt commander: Primo, the Unbounded)
theme: +1/+1 counters + expanding X-spells — grow Hydras and counter-matters creatures (Forgotten Ancient, Ozolith, Hardened Scales) while ramping into huge X-spell payoffs (Stroke of Genius, Hydroid Krasis, Eureka Moment)

name: Squirreled Away (Squirrels) — Bloomburrow Commander Precon
commander: Hazel of the Rootbloom (featured alt commander: The Odd Acorn Gang)
theme: Squirrel tokens + sacrifice/aristocrats — flood the board with Squirrel tokens (Chatterfang, Squirrel Nest, Chatterstorm, Scurry of Squirrels), then convert them into drain and card draw via sacrifice payoffs (Zulaport Cutthroat, Bastion of Remembrance, Nadier's Nightblade, Ravenous Squirrel, Skullclamp)

name: Animated Army — Bloomburrow Commander Precon
commander: Bello, Bard of the Brambles (featured alt commander: Wildsear, Scouring Maw)
theme: Permanents-matter — Bello turns big non-Equipment artifacts and non-Aura enchantments (mana value 4+) into indestructible 4/4 Elemental creatures with haste that draw a card on combat damage; ramp package (Farseek, Cultivate, Explore) into a wide, hard-to-remove board

name: Blood Rites — The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander Precon
commander: Clavileño, First of the Blessed (featured alt commander: Carmen, Cruel Skymarcher)
theme: Vampire aristocrats — swarm with Vampire tokens and creatures, attack to trigger Clavileño's curse (turns attacking creatures into more powerful Demons), then sacrifice for value with Blood Artist/Cruel Celebrant/Indulgent Aristocrat-style drain payoffs; lifegain and sacrifice-for-value throughout

name: Eternal Might — Aetherdrift Commander Precon
commander: Temmet, Naktamun's Will (featured alt commander: Hashaton, Scarab's Fist)
theme: Zombies + card draw/discard engine — Temmet draws and discards on attack, and gives your Zombies +1/+1 until end of turn whenever you draw a card (triggering twice on an attack turn); embalm/eternalize graveyard recursion (Timeless Dragon, Champion of Wits, God-Eternal Oketra) adds resilience

name: Family Matters — Bloomburrow Commander Precon
commander: Zinnia, Valley's Voice (featured alt commander: Arthur, Marigold Knight)
theme: Mice typal / small creatures — flood the board with cheap creatures, then draw extra cards off ones with low power via Zinnia; "offspring" token-copy mechanic supports going wide

name: Silverquill Influence — Secrets of Strixhaven Commander Precon
commander: Killian, Decisive Mentor (featured alt commander: Scriv, the Obligator)
theme: Auras + goad — every enchantment you cast goads an opponent's creature (forcing bad attacks), while Auras attached to your creatures reward you with card draw when those creatures attack; grindy, buys time to get into position

name: Sneak Attack — Zendikar Rising Commander Precon
commander: Anowon, the Ruin Thief
theme: Rogue typal + mill — attack with unblockable/evasive Rogues, mill opponents on combat damage via Anowon, then punish milled creature cards by drawing extra cards; reanimation package (Fated Return, Rise from the Grave, Necromantic Selection) recurs milled threats

name: Sultai Arisen (Tarkir) — Tarkir: Dragonstorm Commander Precon
commander: Teval, the Balanced Scale (featured alt commander: Kotis, Sibsig Champion)
theme: Graveyard value engine — self-mill fills the yard, then every card that leaves the graveyard (recursion, casting from it, etc.) generates value: Teval mills on attack and returns lands, and cards leaving the graveyard make 2/2 Zombie Druid tokens; Kotis lets you cast a creature from the graveyard once per turn and grows off graveyard-sourced creatures entering

name: Abzan Armor (Tarkir) — Tarkir: Dragonstorm Commander Precon
commander: Felothar the Steadfast (featured alt commander: Betor, Ancestor's Voice)
theme: Toughness-matters defenders — Felothar makes every creature you control deal combat damage equal to its toughness and lets walls attack through defender, so fat-butt blockers (Towering Titan, Indomitable Ancients, Tree of Redemption, Wall of Limbs, Weathered Sentinels) become the offense; Assault Formation is a redundant copy of that effect. Axebane Guardian and Overgrown Battlement ramp off the same defenders. Betor turns the lifegain half (Rhox Faithmender, Wall of Reverence, Indulging Patrician) into +1/+1 counters and reanimates on the life-loss half. Felothar also sacs a big-toughness creature to draw cards equal to its toughness, which is nearly free on 0-power walls.

name: Blight Curse — Lorwyn Eclipsed Commander Precon
commander: Auntie Ool, Cursewretch (featured alt commander: The Reaper, King No More)
theme: -1/-1 counters + blight mechanic — shrink and kill opponents' creatures with -1/-1 counters while draining/drawing off Auntie Ool whenever counters land; a strategy never used in a Commander precon before

name: World Shaper — Edge of Eternities Commander Precon
commander: Szarel, Genesis Shepherd (featured alt commander: Hearthhull, the Worldseed)
bracket: 2 (0 Game Changers, per Archidekt's Core/2 estimate)
theme: Sacrifice lands for value, then recur them — Szarel puts +1/+1 counters on a creature whenever you sacrifice a permanent; a deep land-sacrifice/recursion package (Titania, The Gitrog Monster, Splendid Reclamation, Worldsoul's Rage) turns your own lands into a renewable resource

name: Planeswalker Party — Commander Masters Commander Precon
commander: Commodore Guff (planeswalker that can be your commander)
bracket: 3 (1 Game Changer: Narset, Parter of Veils)
theme: Superfriends — 17 planeswalkers in the 99. Guff adds a loyalty counter to another walker each end step and his -3 draws/burns for X = walkers you control. Proliferate (Flux Channeler, Thrummingbird, Grateful Apparition, Karn's Bastion), loyalty-ability doublers (Oath of Teferi, The Chain Veil, Leori, Jaya's Phoenix, Repeated Reverberation) and attack deterrents protecting the walkers (Norn's Annex, Onakke Oathkeeper, Silent Arbiter, Fog Bank, Wall of Denial, Promise of Loyalty).

name: Counter Blitz — Final Fantasy X Commander Precon
commander: Tidus, Yuna's Guardian (alt commander in the 99: Yuna, Grand Summoner)
theme: +1/+1 counters — accumulate, move, and proliferate counters; go wide and tall
status: Precon, modified — 3 GW lands moved to Feather Storm
